earn_money_statistics_accordion_weekly_s: What is the weekly salary system?
*Established to allow players to get more bonuses, you can not only earn commissions, but also receive weekly salary bonuses based on the agent level every week.
*The higher the agent level, the higher the weekly salary bonus you will get, and you can get a maximum weekly salary bonus of {{Amount}}.
*We have divided 13 agent levels based on the recommended number of active users and betting amount.
*Upgrade conditions require that the number of active users and the amount of bets meet the requirements at the same time. The higher your agent level, the higher your weekly salary bonus.
*Weekly salary rewards are distributed at 24:00 every Sunday and the agent level is reset.
earn_money_statistics_accordion_improve_: How to improve the weekly salary level?
*The more members you get into the game through your referral link, and the more they stake, the higher your weekly pay level will be.
*If you have excellent channel promotion capabilities, please contact our customer service center for certification, and you will receive more rewards.
earn_money_statistics_accordion_convert_: How to convert friends into members?

*Log in to {{productName}}, share your recommendation link with your friends on the recommendation page, and guide them to download and register through the recommendation link to become your direct member.
*Indirect members: Encourage your direct members to invite their friends to play games, and the friends they invite will become your indirect members.
*When your direct members and invited friends become your indirect members, you can get more commissions and weekly salary bonuses.
earn_money_statistics_accordion_weekly_s: What are the weekly salary rules?
*Your reward will be calculated based on the total bet amount of your members, The reward earned can either be withdrawn or used for further betting.
*Refer as many friends as you can to gain bigger percentage of rebates.
*Earn lifetime revenue on your referred players.
*Settlement and agent level reset at 24:00 every week.
*Special note: Active players are only counted once per day and can be recalculated the next day.

*For example: PlayerA’s bet of ₹{{aAmount}} will be counte donce, and any bet over ₹{{bAmount}} the next day will be counted once. Players B and C each bet ₹{{abAmount}} on the same day, which will be counted as 2 active players.

earn_rules_faq_q1_question: Q1: What does commission split mean?
earn_rules_faq_q1_answer: A1: After inviting friends to join the application and bind your invitation code, you will receive additional commission based on the consumption of these friends at a certain ratio.
earn_rules_faq_q2_answer: A2: Your club consists of all your agent team members.
earn_rules_faq_q3_question: Q3: How can I upgrade to a higher club level rating?
earn_rules_faq_q3_answer: A3: You can upgrade by inviting more friends or collectively consuming with team members. For more detailed information, please refer to the upgrade requirements table.
earn_rules_faq_q4_question: Q4: How do I receive rewards?
earn_rules_faq_q4_answer: A4: Once your friends or your friends' invitations make purchases, you will immediately receive all rewards, which will be deposited into your commission account and can be withdrawn to your wallet the next day.
earn_rules_faq_q5_question: Q5: Are there any wagering requirements for withdrawing rewards?
earn_rules_faq_q5_answer: A5: There is a one-time wagering requirement.
earn_rules_faq_q6_question: Q6: When can I use my rewards?
earn_rules_faq_q6_answer: A6: You can withdraw your rewards to your wallet for spending the next day. Sometimes there may be slight delays. Thank you for your understanding.
